propositions: Compacted authorship-ledger entries retain pre-rewrite commit SHAs, causing the verifier to misclassify events after commit-history rewrite despite unchanged tree and position.

The verifier must treat ledger commit_sha as a cache and resolve positions against current-history, preferring resolved commits over recorded SHAs, with recorded SHA as fallback when position resolution fails.
A real-Git regression must prove that signed events with non-null pre-rewrite commit SHAs are correctly verified post-rewrite when positions resolve to new SHAs.
Ledger schema, event bytes, live-event behavior, and null-commit recovery behavior must remain unchanged after the fix.
Post-fix verification must report identical summary counts and identical (event_uuid, verdict, grandfathered) multisets across pre-rewrite and post-rewrite scans.
